name: OpenStreetMap India — Building Footprints
geography: India (national coverage; urban areas better mapped than rural)
date: Continuously updated; snapshot date must be recorded at download time
resolution: Vector polygons (no inherent resolution); accuracy varies by contributor and region
labels: Building footprint polygons. Some records include: building:levels (floor count), height, building type. Data completeness and accuracy vary widely by city.
license: Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0. Attribution required: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.
provenance: Available via Geofabrik India extract (updated daily). Also accessible via Overpass API for targeted queries.
limitations: CROWD-SOURCED — NOT authoritative cadastral data. NOT official Indian government data. Significant incompleteness in rural and peri-urban areas. Building levels and height data sparse (<10% of buildings). Positional accuracy unverified at cadastral scale. DO NOT use as ground truth for legal/registration purposes. Suitable as noisy pseudo-labels or validation reference only.
intended_use: Task 1 (building extraction — noisy pseudo-label reference), Task 4 (floor detection — weak supervision where building:levels available)
